findings.evidence: python/tests/test_pager.py:43-66: test_cli_rejects_size_below_one and test_cli_rejects_negative_size_with_status_2 are the same subprocess call and the same three assertions, differing only in the --size argument ("0" at line 45, "-3" at line 58).
findings.fix: Collapse the two into one test decorated with @pytest.mark.parametrize("size", ["0", "-3"]) that runs [sys.executable, "-m", "pager", "--size", size] and keeps the three assertions; pytest is already imported.
